mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pro_workorder_operation (operation_id, action_type, request_digest, owner_id, workorder_id, expected_version, outcome, error_code, workorder_code, workorder_version, committed_at) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{action}, #{requestDigest}, #{ownerId}, #{workorderId}, #{expectedVersion}, #{outcome}, #{errorCode}, #{workorderCode}, #{workorderVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE pro_workorder_operation SET workorder_id = #{workorderId}, workorder_code = #{workorderCode}, workorder_version = #{workorderVersion}, outcome = 'succeeded', committed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND outcome = 'executing'
